items.title: Espressif ESP32-C61-MINI-1/1U Wi-Fi 6 and BLE IoT module launched for about $2
items.summary: Back in 2024, Espressif Systems introduced the ESP32-C61 2.4 GHz WiFi 6 and Bluetooth LE (BLE) SoC as a low-cost variant of the ESP32-C6 without an 802.15.4 radio, a single RISC-V core, and lower-capacity SRAM (320KB vs 512KB). We had first seen the ESP32-C61 in the Wireless Tag ESP32P4C61 board introduced last June in a Kickstarter campaign last June, but Espressif has now started to sell samples of the ESP32-C61-MINI-1 and ESP32-C61-MINI-1U on AliExpress for $10.7 for a pack of 5 pieces, or around $2 per module. ESP32-C61-MINI-1/1U Module specifications: SoC – ESP32-C61 CPU core – Single-core 32-bit RISC-V microprocessor up to 160 MHz Memory 320KB SRAM Up to 8 MB PSRAM Storage 256KB ROM Up to 8 MB Quad SPI flash Wireless 2.4 GHz WiFi 1T1R Frequency: 2412 ~ 2484 MHz IEEE 802.11ax-compliant 20 MHz-only non-AP mode MCS0 ~ MCS9 Uplink and downlink OFDMA Downlink MU-MIMO Target wake time [...] The post Espressif ESP32-C61-MINI-1/1U Wi-Fi 6 and BLE IoT module launched for about $2 appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: 乐鑫ESP32-C61-MINI-1/1U Wi-Fi 6与BLE模组上市，单价约2美元
items.summary_zh: 乐鑫推出ESP32-C61-MINI-1/1U物联网模组，AliExpress五片装约10.7美元，单片约2美元。该模组搭载ESP32-C61 SoC，采用单核32位RISC-V架构，主频最高160MHz，配备320KB SRAM和256KB ROM，支持2.4GHz Wi-Fi 6和BLE，但不含802.15.4射频，是ESP32-C6的低成本版本。
items.why_it_matters_zh: ESP32-C61作为ESP32-C6的低成本精简版，以约2美元单价提供Wi-Fi 6连接能力，进一步降低了RISC-V物联网模组的入门门槛。

items.title: Maker Go ESP32-C5-EVB board features RS-485 interface, four relays, four opto-isolated inputs
items.summary: Maker Go ESP32-C5-EVB is an ESP32-C5 board with four relays, four opto-isolated inputs, RS-485 communication, and support for Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth Low Energy 5.0, and Thread/Zigbee connectivity. It’s a variant of the Maker Go ESP32-C6-EVB released in 2024 that replaces the ESP32-C6 module with an ESP32-C5 module and a GPIO header with a terminal block for RS-485. The Maker Go ESP32-C6-EVB was mostly a clone of the Olimex ESP32-C6-EVB, and while Olimex already released its own ESP32-C5-EVB, it has a different dual-channel relay design. Maker Go ESP32-C5-EVB specifications: Wireless module – DOIT ESPC5-32 module SoC – Espressif Systems ESP32-C5 CPU Single-core 32-bit RISC-V processor @ up to 240 MHz Low-power RISC-V core @ 40 MHz acting as the main processor for power-sensitive applications Memory – 384 KB SRAM on-chip, support for external PSRAM Storage – 320 KB ROM, support for external flash Connectivity Dual-band 802.11ax WiFi 6 in the 2.4GHz [...] The post Maker Go ESP32-C5-EVB board features RS-485 interface, four relays, four opto-isolated inputs appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: ESP-KVM – An open-source IP KVM solution based on ESP32-P4 RISC-V MCU
items.summary: Earlier this month, the P4 KVM project was brought to my attention. It provides IP KVM functionality to a Waveshare ESP32-P4-WIFI6-POE-ETH board when paired with a Toshiba TC358743 HDMI-to-CSI adapter. However, it doesn’t work with the new ESP32-P4 V3.x variants featuring a proper H.264 video encoding implementation, and the developer (Jonathan Rowny) says it’s just a proof-of-concept with many bugs and no security, so I decided to skip it. The good news is that he also encouraged others to fork the project, and Evgenij Spitsyn did just that with the release of the ESP-KVM project, which supports both MJPEG and H.264 encoding and a range of other features. ESP-KVM highlights: Video capture, resolution changes, and MJPEG or H.264 encoding Keyboard, absolute and relative pointer, media keys, copy/paste Touch mode for phones and tablets (trackpad, on-screen keyboard) Multiple viewers, one in control at a time with takeover HTTPS, login, physical password [...] The post ESP-KVM – An open-source IP KVM solution based on ESP32-P4 RISC-V MCU appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.title: SensWear – An open-source modular Nordic nRF54L15 development platform for wearables
items.summary: SensWear is an open-source hardware development platform for wearables based on Nordic nRF54L15 Bluetooth LE SoC and a range of sensors designed for researchers, developers, and companies building smart rings, wristbands, patches, and other custom devices. The solution is mainly comprised of flexible boards, including the SensWear core board with an nRF54L15 MCU and a 6-axis IMU sensor, and daughter boards with either PPG and optical sensing, temperature sensing, capacitive touch sensing, or haptic feedback. items.title: Waveshare RP2350-POE-ETH – A Raspberry Pi RP2350 MCU board with PoE
items.summary: Waveshare RP2350-POE-ETH is a Raspberry Pi RP2350 board with Ethernet implemented through a W6300 chip, support for optional PoE (Power-over-Ethernet), and two GPIO headers. We had covered a few Raspberry Pi RP2350 boards with Ethernet from WIZNet, including the W5100S-EVB-Pico2, W5500-EVB-Pico2, and W6300-EVB-Pico2, but none were advertised with PoE at the time. Since then, the 4-pin WizPOE-P1 module changes that, and the Waveshare RP2350-POE-ETH board offers a more affordable option. Waveshare RP2350-POE-ETH specifications: Microcontroller – Raspberry Pi RP2350A CPU Dual-core Arm Cortex-M33 processor @ 150 MHz Dual-core 32-bit RISC-V Hazard3 @ 150 MHz Up to two cores can be used at a time, either 2x Arm, 2x RISC-V, or 1x Arm + 1x RISC-V Memory – 520KB internal RAM Storage – 8KB OTP Storage Storage – 16Mbit SPI NOR flash Ethernet 10/100Mbps Ethernet RJ45 port via WIZnet W6300 “iEthernet” chip 6-pin PoE connector for optional module USB – USB 1.1 C-Type [...] The post Waveshare RP2350-POE-ETH – A Raspberry Pi RP2350 MCU board with PoE appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .

items.why_it_matters_zh: 该板是首款支持PoE的RP2350开发板，价格更亲民，适合需要以太网供电的工业与嵌入式应用。

items.title: LILYGO T-Display C5 board features 1.9-inch IPS color LCD, battery support, Qwiic expansion connectors
items.summary: LILYGO T-Display C5 is an ESP32-C5 board with a 1.9-inch IPS color LCD, a USB-C port for power and programming, Lithium battery support, and GPIO expansion via headers and two Qwiic expansion connectors. The main benefit of using an ESP32-C5 chip is support for dual-band WiFi 6 connectivity (2.4/5.0 GHz), and it also keeps Bluetooth LE 5.x and the 802.15.4 radio for Zigbee/Thread/Matter found in the ESP32-C6. items.why_it_matters_zh: 为学习者提供了双发射 RISC-V CPU 的教学参考实现。

items.title: joshheyse/riscv updated on GitHub
items.summary: A projet to learn processor design and System Verilog FPGA development Stars: 0.
items.title_zh: RISC-V处理器设计与SystemVerilog FPGA开发学习项目更新
items.summary_zh: 一个用于学习处理器设计和SystemVerilog FPGA开发的项目，通过动手实践帮助开发者掌握RISC-V架构与硬件描述语言编程基础。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 为零基础学习者提供CPU设计与FPGA开发入门路径，但目前Star数较少仍属早期阶段。

items.title: jakariya12124/emuko updated on GitHub
items.summary: Emulate RISC-V quickly with emuko, a Rust-based emulator that boots Linux and supports JIT, snapshotting, and an HTTP API for advanced usage. Stars: 0.
items.title_zh: 基于Rust的RISC-V模拟器emuko项目更新
items.summary_zh: emuko是一款使用Rust编写的RISC-V快速模拟器，可启动Linux，并支持JIT编译、快照功能以及HTTP API接口，便于用户进行高级仿真与测试。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 集成JIT与快照等高级特性，为RISC-V软件验证与系统开发提供轻量高效的开源工具。

items.title: Linux Patched For Safe RET Interrupt Vulnerability
items.summary: Made public minutes ago is the Safe RET Interrupt Vulnerability which is now patched in the newest Linux kernel Git code. The Safe RET Interrupt Vulnerability stems from improper handling within Linux's Speculative Return Stack Overflow (SRSO) mitigation affecting AMD Zen 1 through Zen 4 processors...
items.title_zh: Linux内核修复Safe RET中断漏洞，影响AMD Zen 1至Zen 4处理器
items.summary_zh: Linux内核Git最新代码已修复Safe RET中断漏洞。该漏洞源于Linux对推测性返回栈溢出（SRSO）缓解措施处理不当，影响AMD Zen 1至Zen 4系列处理器。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该漏洞涉及推测执行安全机制，可能对AMD Zen系列服务器及桌面平台造成安全风险。

items.title: Apple NVMe Linux Driver Sees Fixes After Being Bitten By New Firmware
items.summary: A set of patches providing fixes for the Apple Silicon NVMe driver for the Linux kernel were sent out today due to new issues cropping up when running newer Apple firmware. Firmware shipped by macOS 15+ is causing issues with the current Apple NVMe open-source Linux driver developed by the Asahi Linux crew...
items.title_zh: Apple Silicon NVMe Linux驱动因新固件问题获修复补丁
items.summary_zh: Asahi Linux团队开发的Apple Silicon NVMe开源Linux驱动收到一批修复补丁。问题由macOS 15及以上版本附带的新固件引发，导致驱动在运行新固件时出现兼容性问题。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该补丁影响Apple Silicon设备上运行Linux的兼容性，是Asahi Linux项目的关键进展。

items.title: Linux Wireless Maintainer Takes Firm Stance Against AI/LLM Generated Slop Patches
items.summary: In addition to the Linux kernel staging area now rejecting AI/LLM-generated patches except for real security fixes, the Linux wireless networking code is also seeing some shifts around how it will deal with AI/LLM generated patches...
items.title_zh: Linux无线网络维护者明确拒绝AI/LLM生成的代码补丁
items.summary_zh: 继Linux内核staging区域拒绝AI/LLM生成补丁（仅接受真正的安全修复）后，Linux无线网络代码也开始调整其处理AI/LLM生成补丁的策略。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 主流内核维护者集体抵制AI生成代码，反映社区对代码质量与真实贡献的重视。

items.title: AMD GFX1171 Support Merged For Mesa 26.3
items.summary: Earlier this year we began seeing patches for AMD GFX1170 graphics IP labeled as "RDNA 4m" and that was then completed with also adding GFX1171 and GFX1172 as additional targets for the AMDGPU LLVM compiler back-end and AMDGPU kernel driver. Merged today for Mesa 26.3 is now adding the GFX1171 target to Mesa 26.3 for the RADV and RadeonSI drivers...
items.title_zh: AMD GFX1171支持合入Mesa 26.3
items.summary_zh: 继AMD GFX1170（代号"RDNA 4m"）相关补丁之后，GFX1171和GFX1172陆续加入AMDGPU LLVM编译器后端和AMDGPU内核驱动的目标列表。GFX1171现已合入Mesa 26.3，为RADV和RadeonSI驱动提供支持。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 新GFX IP支持合入上游Mesa，意味着AMD新一代RDNA图形硬件的软件栈正在快速完善。

items.title: Qualcomm Proposes Synx For The Linux Kernel With "Significant" Power + Performance Benefits
items.summary: Qualcomm engineers have initiated a discussion over upstreaming Synx to the Linux kernel, which is a global synchronization framework across different parts of SoCs. Qualcomm is already using Synx internally and is reported to provide "significant" power and performance benefits...
items.title_zh: 高通提议将Synx同步框架上游合并至Linux内核
items.summary_zh: 高通工程师发起讨论，计划将内部使用的Synx全局同步框架上游合并至Linux内核。Synx用于在SoC不同模块间进行同步，据称可带来显著的功耗与性能改善。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 体现高通持续加大对Linux上游贡献，同步机制优化有望提升移动及嵌入式SoC的能效表现。

items.title: AMD Posts Proposal & Linux Patches For eSPI Subsystem
items.summary: AMD has posted patches proposing a new Linux subsystem for the Enhanced Serial Peripheral Interface (eSPI) standard that was in turn originally developed by Intel. With AMD now making use of eSPI, they are proposing a new subsystem for it within the Linux kernel, which includes a new driver for their hardware...
items.title_zh: AMD提交Linux内核eSPI子系统提案及相关补丁
items.summary_zh: AMD发布补丁，提议在Linux内核中为Enhanced Serial Peripheral Interface（eSPI）标准建立新子系统，并提供配套驱动支持。eSPI最初由Intel制定，AMD现在也开始采用。
items.why_it_matters_zh: eSPI正逐步成为跨厂商通用接口标准，AMD入局意味着该接口在x86平台生态中的覆盖进一步扩大。

items.title: Linux's Staging Area To Now Reject LLM-Generated Patches, Except For Real Security Fixes
items.summary: While Linux's second-in-command Greg Kroah-Hartman does use AI / LLMs himself to success in the Linux kernel, given the "onslaught" of kernel patches produced by large language models and the intent on the Linux kernel's staging area being an area for newcomers to get involved, moving forward he's now rejecting AI/LLM-generated staging patches. But there is one exception and that is for genuinely valid security fixes...
items.title_zh: Linux内核staging区将拒绝LLM生成的补丁
items.summary_zh: Linux内核维护者Greg Kroah-Hartman宣布，鉴于大量大语言模型生成的内核补丁涌入，且staging区本是为新开发者提供的入门区域，他将拒绝AI/LLM生成的staging补丁，但真正的安全修复除外。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 凸显Linux社区对AI生成代码质量的担忧，旨在维护代码质量与新人参与门槛的平衡。

items.title: $299.99 ASUS UGen300 USB AI accelerator combines 40 TOPS Hailo-10H chip with 8GB LPDDR4
items.summary: ASUS UGen300 USB AI accelerator features a 40 TOPS Hailo-10H AI processor and 8GB of LPDDR4 memory to support large language models (LLMs), vision language models (VLMs), and AI vision workloads while consuming less than 2.5 Watts. In some ways, the hardware is similar to the Raspberry Pi AI HAT+ 2, but in a slim dongle form factor (105 x 50 x 18mm) and a 10 Gbps USB 3.2 Gen1 USB-C Type-C port instead of a 5 or 8 GT/s PCIe interface. ASUS UGen300 USB AI accelerator (UGen300-USB-8G) specifications: AI accelerator – Hailo Hailo-10H delivering up to 40 TOPS (INT4) or 20 TOPS (INT8) inferencing performance Memory – 8GB LPDDR4 @ 4266 MT/s Host interface – USB 3.1 Gen2 (10 Gbps) Type-C port Power Supply – 5V via USB-C port Power Consumption – 2.5 Watts (typical) Dimensions – 105 x 50 x 18 mm Weight – 145 grams ASUS says the [...] The post $299.99 ASUS UGen300 USB AI accelerator combines 40 TOPS Hailo-10H chip with 8GB LPDDR4 appeared first on CNX Software - Embedded Systems News .
items.title_zh: 华硕推出UGen300 USB AI加速器：搭载Hailo-10H，售299.99美元
items.summary_zh: 华硕UGen300 USB AI加速器搭载Hailo-10H AI处理器，提供40 TOPS INT4推理性能与8GB LPDDR4内存，配备USB 3.1 Gen2 Type-C接口，典型功耗仅2.5W，可运行LLM、VLM及AI视觉工作负载。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 紧凑型USB dongle形态的端侧AI推理方案，以低功耗降低AI模型本地部署门槛。
